purpose: Rank the current complete-device component burden before replacing the outward SMA family, and keep small-lot purchasing penalties separate from quantity-100 material cost.

display_orientation_review.observed: The official complete-donor rear view proves a folded display flex and rear ZIF path, but does not disclose the standalone HMX035CTFT-001 tail outline, exit edge, free length, stiffener or production-lot invariance.
display_orientation_review.preferred_rule: Physically orient the received panel so its flex points toward the antenna edge, then rotate display memory and touch coordinates in firmware. Do not allow the tail to enter the LED, D-pad or function-button zone.

paper_fit.firmware_change: ST77922 orientation plus touch-coordinate transform only

display_orientation_review.remaining_gate: Received HMX035CTFT-001 tail length, bend radius, contact side and retention must prove the upper adapter path before it replaces the lower working position.

optimization_lanes.title: Replace safe equivalent pre-order passives and ordinary logic with in-stock JLCPCB parts
optimization_lanes.evidence: The normalized five-device evidence charges USD 842.9365 for 42 pre-order rows versus USD 362.2315 for the same rows on their quantity-100 material basis; the observed small-lot premium is USD 480.705 before full quotation.
optimization_lanes.action: Review every pre-order row against its substitution class; only exact or no-worse parametric replacements may be accepted.

optimization_lanes.title: Replace the ten GCT bulkhead-style SMA/RP-SMA bodies with factory-placeable edge connectors and a shared protective frame
optimization_lanes.evidence: The current ten GCT bodies contribute USD 24.6456 per device at the quantity-100 source tier and have no demonstrated current JLCPCB route; their individual nuts do not transfer load without a real enclosure wall.
optimization_lanes.action: Search an exact standard/reverse pair with mechanical board tabs, 1.6-mm PCB fit and at least 6-GHz rating for native paths.

optimization_lanes.title: Re-evaluate eight RF power detectors without weakening real-TX evidence
optimization_lanes.evidence: Six AD8314 plus two LTC5532 contribute USD 24.9174 per device at quantity 100; the live five-device requirement is USD 276.70 and both families require pre-order for the complete quantity.
optimization_lanes.action: Compare factory-stocked detectors and calibrated diode cells per band. Keep independent evidence for the three concurrently active nRF24 paths.

optimization_lanes.title: Find one serial in-stock tact-switch family for all sixteen ordinary controls
optimization_lanes.evidence: B3S-1100P contributes USD 10.248 per device at quantity 100 and USD 74.58 for 80 pieces in the five-device pre-order route.
optimization_lanes.action: Preserve footprint/enclosure reach, force, height, endurance and recessed actuation.

optimization_lanes.title: Reduce five U.FL receptacle plus 30-mm jumper paths by source-to-port placement
optimization_lanes.evidence: Five board U.FL plus five TE jumpers contribute USD 14.433 per device at quantity 100, before assembly handling.
optimization_lanes.action: Remove a cable only where a short controlled-impedance direct path preserves module keep-outs, repairability and coexistence.

optimization_lanes.title: Compare the 1048P holder with serial cell contacts captured by the enclosure cradle
optimization_lanes.evidence: 1048P contributes USD 8.57 per device at quantity 100 and is currently stock-zero pre-order at JLCPCB.
optimization_lanes.action: Any replacement must keep protected-cell length tolerance, polarity, insertion cycles and a non-peeling enclosure load path.

optimization_lanes.title: Replace three premium DBG10 headers with an equally keyed serial factory-stocked family
optimization_lanes.evidence: Three Samtec FTSH headers contribute USD 5.0973 per device and exist only as opened-sandwich recovery fallbacks.
optimization_lanes.action: Preserve independent S3/C5/RP recovery, keying, pitch, probe access and the internal height envelope.

optimization_lanes.title: Obtain the standalone panel route instead of consuming a complete donor per device
optimization_lanes.evidence: The current reachable DLE06235B donor is USD 20.90 per display, while standalone HMX035CTFT-001 price and production identity remain open.
optimization_lanes.action: Keep the replaceable adapter and treat the donor as an EVT ceiling, not production COGS.
